dhp320:0.3: _Nāga_ can mean either “elephant” or “dragon”, and is also commonly used as a metaphor for a very advanced spiritual practitioner.
dhp320:3: _Ativākya_ literally means “excessive speech”; however, it usually refers to criticism or verbal abuse.
dhp326:3: _Yoniso_ comes from the word _yoni_ which means “womb, source, origin.” _Yoniso_ therefore means “based on causality,” and in the suttas is used to mean acting wisely as a result of understanding causality.
